verdict.rationale: Choosing a data-storage region is a fair question for a cloud code-hosting service, so the axis applies. The pack never documents data residency or region selection for Bitbucket Cloud. The related material does not deliver the capability: GDPR/SOC2/ISO compliance and encryption at rest are adjacent privacy controls, and the mentions of Data Center only describe migrating to Cloud, not choosing where data lives.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
